D:\click here\2代目\dv_ready_2021_2022

## Description
This folder contains the exchange-level BTCUSD minute data restricted to the 2021–2022 paper sample, with dollar-volume (DV) variables already constructed. It is the direct upstream input for the aggregation and concentration panels used in the paper.

## Time range
2021–2022, one-minute BTCUSD data.

## Key variables
Typical exchange-level fields include:
- time_utc / synchronized minute index
- exchange identifier
- venue-level BTCUSD price
- raw volume
- dollar-volume (DV)
- scaling-related fields where applicable

## Generated by
- make_dv_2021_2022.py
- volume and coverage checking scripts in `src/build/`

## Used in paper
These files provide the exchange-level minute inputs for the main BTCUSD empirical setting described in Sections 2 and 3 of the paper. They underlie the construction of VWAP, LWMP, dominant share, and concentration measures used in the main text and appendix. 

## File status
These files are not included in the GitHub repository because they are large intermediate data objects.

## Actual storage location
Currently stored locally.

## Notes
This is the most relevant exchange-level input layer for reproducing the paper sample used in the submitted manuscript.
